purpose: Record the model-generation confound and update policy in the Issue #294 maintained-HOMR replacement investigation.

interpretation.primary_gate: Freeze current-x4/OMR support and control geometry; compare A, B and an immutable latest-main commit after hybrid consensus, dense candidate reconstruction, CNN scoring and MeasureNumberingPipeline.
interpretation.production_update_policy: Never track main as a floating production dependency. Discover main, resolve an immutable commit, capture model/runtime provenance, run focused/full gates, then manually promote the pinned commit only after acceptance.
interpretation.ground_truth_role: Optional diagnostic; missing local GT must not block the operational downstream gate.
interpretation.musicxml_role: Not an acceptance gate for the Stage-E baseline when downstream barline/count/topology/numbering material is preserved.
